question: Which of the following movies won the ‘Best Tamil Film’ award at the 66th National Film Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Baaram.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Baaram movie won the ‘Best Tamil Film’ award at the 66th National Film Awards.**
 
• **The 66th National Film** awards were announced by Rahul Rawail, head of the Jury for feature films, almost Four hundred and nineteen films

 competed for the awards this year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The national film awards are given in** 31 categories**.
 
• Best non-feature film: Son-Rise by Vibha Bakshi and The Secret Life of Frogs by Ajay and Vijay Bedi.
 
• Best Educational Film: Sarala Virala.
 
• Best Director: Uri: The Surgical Strike- Aditya Dhar.
 
• Best Feature Film: Hellaro is a Gujarati film directed by Abhishek Shah.
 
• Best Actor: Ayushmann Khuranna for Andhadhun and Vicky Kaushal for Uri: The Surgical Strike.
 
• Best Music Direction (Songs): Sanjay Leela Bhansali for Padmaavat.
 
• Best Female Playback Singer: Bindhu Malini for Mayavi Manave from Nathichirami (Kannada).
 
• Best Male Playback Singer: Arijit Singh for Bhinte Dhil.
